LanguageData.LP_Festival_Lathander.label: Greengrass
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Lathander.description: Lathander's festival, held at the altar. Celebrate rebirth in the morning light. +10% quality when started by day.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Tyr.label: Shieldmeet
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Tyr.description: Tyr's festival, held at the altar. Reaffirm vows and settle disputes. Every 4 years (years divisible by 4) is a Great Shieldmeet: divine favor result ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Mystra.label: Night of the Weave
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Mystra.description: Mystra's festival, held at the altar. Salute the Weave under the stars. +10% quality when started at night, +3% for each spellcasting participant.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Kelemvor.label: Feast of the Dead
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Kelemvor.description: Kelemvor's festival, held at the altar. Share a meal with the departed and send off restless spirits. +10% quality when there's an occupied grave or sarcophagus on the map.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Malar.label: Great Hunt
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Malar.description: Malar's festival, held at the altar. Offer prey to the Beastlord. At the start there must be an animal corpse of body size ≥0.7 within 3 cells of the altar, offered when the festival ends.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Talos.label: Storm Song
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Talos.description: Talos's festival, held at the altar. Sing loud in the gale. +25% quality in a thunderstorm.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Bane.label: Day of Tyranny
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Bane.description: Bane's festival, held at the altar. Swear obedience to the Black Hand. +5% quality for each slave present (up to +20%).
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Shar.label: Lightless Vigil
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Shar.description: Shar's festival, held at the altar. Forget pain in darkness. +20% quality at night, another +10% when the altar's cell has under 30% light.
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Surtr.label: Forgefire
LanguageData.LP_Festival_Surtr.description: Surtur's festival, held at the altar. Cast the finest arms and armor into the forge. At the start there must be weapons or armor worth ≥300 in total within 3 cells of the altar, offered when the festival ends.
LanguageData.LP_Funeral_GreyRobe.label: grey-robed funeral
LanguageData.LP_Funeral_GreyRobe.description: A funeral led by Kelemvor's grey-robed priests, replacing the vanilla funeral. The vanilla funeral's effects apply as usual; at "good" or better the dead is laid to rest (can't be raised, soul can't be drained), Kelemvor divine favor +2, "unforgettable" another +3. Not available to cultures of undying eternal night.
LanguageData.LP_Funeral_GreyRobe.extraTextPawnDeathLe: {PAWN_nameDef} should be buried, with a grey-robed funeral so {PAWN_possessive} family and friends can say goodbye and Kelemvor can take {PAWN_possessive} soul.
